engine_requirements: Add adapter option to grants_gov: (1) titleIncludes: string[] applied client-side to oppHits[].title (case-insensitive); (2) oppNum may be an array; (3) optional round_source: {url, pattern: "Round (\d): ([A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4})"} fetched over plain HTTP; deadline = earliest round date >= today, else last round; emit one row per open NOFO with that deadline, and keep grants.gov closeDate as close_date.
